points.title: 游吟诗人时期
points.description: 荷马可能出生于爱琴海地区的某个地方，可能是爱奥尼亚或小亚细亚沿岸。作为盲人游吟诗人，他游历于各个城邦之间，通过吟诵史诗为生。这一时期，他接触了各地的传说、神话和历史故事，为后来的创作积累了丰富的素材。他可能在这一时期开始创作《伊利亚特》和《奥德赛》的早期版本，这些作品最初是通过口头传诵的形式流传。
points.descriptionEn: Homer was likely born somewhere in the Aegean region, possibly in Ionia or along the coast of Anatolia. As a blind rhapsode, he traveled among various city-states, earning his living by reciting epics. During this period, he encountered legends, myths, and historical stories from different regions, accumulating rich material for his later works. He may have begun composing early versions of the Iliad and Odyssey during this time, which were initially transmitted orally.

points.title: 史诗创作期
points.description: 传统认为荷马曾在希俄斯岛定居并创作了《伊利亚特》。这座爱琴海岛屿是当时重要的文化中心，拥有丰富的口头传统。荷马在这里将分散的特洛伊战争传说整合成一部连贯的史诗。他运用了固定的诗行结构和重复的修辞手法，使作品便于记忆和传诵。《伊利亚特》以阿喀琉斯的愤怒为主线，描绘了特洛伊战争最后几十天的故事，展现了英雄主义、荣誉和命运等主题。
points.descriptionEn: Traditionally, Homer is believed to have settled on the island of Chios and composed the Iliad there. This Aegean island was an important cultural center with rich oral traditions. Homer integrated the scattered legends of the Trojan War into a coherent epic here. He employed fixed verse structures and repetitive rhetorical devices, making the work easy to memorize and recite. The Iliad, focusing on Achilles' wrath, depicts the final days of the Trojan War, exploring themes of heroism, honor, and fate.

points.title: 《奥德赛》创作期
points.description: 荷马可能在士麦那（今土耳其伊兹密尔）完成了《奥德赛》的创作。这座城市是当时重要的商业和文化中心，与地中海各地有广泛联系。与《伊利亚特》不同，《奥德赛》更注重个人冒险和智慧，讲述了奥德修斯特洛伊战争后历经十年艰险返回家园的故事。荷马在这里发展了更为复杂的叙事技巧，包括倒叙和多线索叙事。这部作品探讨了忠诚、家庭、智慧和人与神的关系等主题，展现了荷马对人性更深刻的理解。
points.descriptionEn: Homer may have completed the composition of the Odyssey in Smyrna (modern-day Izmir, Turkey). This city was an important commercial and cultural center with extensive connections throughout the Mediterranean. Unlike the Iliad, the Odyssey focuses more on personal adventure and wisdom, telling the story of Odysseus' ten-year journey home after the Trojan War. Here, Homer developed more complex narrative techniques, including flashbacks and multi-thread storytelling. This work explores themes of loyalty, family, wisdom, and the relationship between humans and gods, showing Homer's deeper understanding of human nature.

points.title: 晚年与传承
points.description: 荷马晚年可能在科斯岛度过，并继续完善他的作品。这座岛屿是当时重要的文化中心，有丰富的口头传统。在这里，荷马可能建立了自己的诗歌学派，培养了许多弟子，确保了史诗传统的延续。他的作品通过这些弟人的传承得以保存和传播。荷马的诗歌对古希腊文化产生了深远影响，成为教育的基础和道德准则的来源。他的作品不仅记录了古希腊的历史和神话，也塑造了希腊人的民族认同和文化价值观。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Homer may have spent time on the island of Cos, continuing to refine his works. This island was an important cultural center with rich oral traditions. Here, Homer may have established his own school of poetry, training many disciples who ensured the continuation of the epic tradition. His works were preserved and transmitted through these followers. Homer's poetry had a profound impact on ancient Greek culture, becoming the foundation of education and a source of moral principles. His works not only recorded Greek history and mythology but also shaped Greek national identity and cultural values.

appraisal.zh: 荷马被奉为西方文学的奠基人，《伊利亚特》与《奥德赛》既是文学杰作，也是古希腊文化的百科全书，塑造了后世文学的基本范式与希腊人的文化认同。学界通行的判断仍肯定其典范地位，但也有研究者指出，荷马其人是否存在尚无定论，作品或为多人集体创作，其中对女性、奴隶制的态度及神祇干预人事的叙事，也受到现代视角的质疑。
appraisal.en: Homer is honored as the founder of Western literature: the Iliad and Odyssey are both literary masterpieces and an encyclopedia of Greek culture, shaping later literary paradigms and Greek identity. The prevailing scholarly view still affirms this canonical status, though researchers also note that Homer's existence is uncertain and the epics may be collective creations, while their treatment of women and slavery and their narratives of divine intervention have drawn modern criticism.

supporter.zh: 荷马被誉为西方文学的奠基人，他的史诗作品《伊利亚特》和《奥德赛》不仅是文学杰作，更是古希腊文化的百科全书。他通过精湛的叙事技巧和深刻的人性洞察，塑造了西方文学的基本范式。荷马的作品不仅记录了古希腊的历史和神话，还传递了关于荣誉、勇气、智慧和家庭等永恒价值，对西方文明产生了不可估量的影响。他的诗歌成为古希腊教育的基础，塑造了希腊人的民族认同和文化价值观。
supporter.en: Homer is revered as the founder of Western literature. His epic works, the Iliad and Odyssey, are not only literary masterpieces but also an encyclopedia of ancient Greek culture. Through exquisite narrative techniques and profound insights into human nature, he shaped the fundamental paradigms of Western literature. Homer's works not only recorded Greek history and mythology but also transmitted eternal values about honor, courage, wisdom, and family, exerting immeasurable influence on Western civilization. His poetry became the foundation of Greek education and shaped Greek national identity and cultural values.

critic.zh: 批评者指出荷马的真实性存在争议，历史上可能并无单一作者，而是多位诗人集体创作的结果。他的作品反映了古希腊社会的局限性，包括对女性的歧视、奴隶制的接受以及战争英雄主义的过度美化。此外，荷马史诗中的神祇干预人类事务的叙事方式被现代理性主义者批评为非理性。他的作品也被认为过于强调个人荣誉而忽视集体福祉，这种价值观在现代民主社会中受到质疑。
critic.en: Critics point out the questionable authenticity of Homer, suggesting that there may not have been a single author but rather a collective work by multiple poets. His works reflect the limitations of ancient Greek society, including discrimination against women, acceptance of slavery, and excessive glorification of war heroism. Additionally, the narrative of divine intervention in human affairs in Homer's epics is criticized by modern rationalists as irrational. His works are also seen as overemphasizing individual honor at the expense of collective welfare, a value that is questioned in modern democratic societies.

objective.zh: 从历史学和流行文化视角看，荷马已成为西方文化的重要符号，其作品超越了单纯的文学范畴，成为理解古希腊文明的关键窗口。尽管关于荷马本人的历史信息有限，但他的作品对后世产生了深远影响，从柏拉图到现代作家都从中汲取灵感。在流行文化中，荷马史诗被改编成各种艺术形式，包括电影、戏剧和音乐。学术界对荷马的研究已形成专门的'荷马学'，探讨作者身份、创作背景和文本演变等问题。荷马的作品不仅是文学经典，更是西方文化基因的重要组成部分。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Homer has become an important symbol in Western culture. His works transcend mere literature, serving as key windows to understanding ancient Greek civilization. Despite limited historical information about Homer himself, his works have had a profound influence on later generations, inspiring figures from Plato to modern writers. In popular culture, Homer's epics have been adapted into various art forms, including films, plays, and music. Academic study of Homer has formed a specialized 'Homeric studies,' exploring authorship, creative context, and textual evolution. Homer's works are not only literary classics but also essential components of Western cultural DNA.

self.zh: 人啊，命运之神赐予我们的一切，我们必须接受，无论是好是坏。
self.en: Mortals, whatever the gods give us, we must accept, whether it is good or bad.
